explanation: The hypothesis closely reconstructs the target: inverse-radius two-phase melting, preferential Fe/Cu mobility, Fe energetic destabilization, absence of a persistent liquid shell or elemental clustering, and convergence toward a 2184 K bulk limit. The initial state, size range, simulation method, controls, boundaries, measurements, and falsification criteria are all well matched. Minor shortcomings are omission of the 0–300 K preparation schedule and 1 fs timestep, and wording that places early Fe/Cu mobility primarily at the surface before the core, whereas the target emphasizes enhanced diffusion from both surface and core. It also does not explicitly summarize the prior Ag, Au, Al, Pd, and bimetallic findings requested, and provides no evidence identifiers, although it avoids unsupported citation claims. These issues do not materially alter the reconstructed mechanism or predictions.
